overview: Medford High School students presented a Mustang Report broadcast featuring student interviews, musical performances, staff profiles, and winter sports updates.

items.title: Student Interview with Lydia Ryan
items.summary: Ruby Fernandez interviewed gymnastics team member Lydia Ryan about her favorite movies, season preferences, and sports background.

items.title: Student Musical Performances
items.summary: Students performed vocal selections, including covers of songs by Regina Spektor, Justin Bieber, Frank Sinatra, and Alicia Keys.

items.title: Main Office Staff Profile
items.summary: Mr. McLaughlin described his role supporting students in the main office and discussed his background in education and balloon art.

items.title: Patriots Game Predictions
items.summary: Students and staff shared score predictions for the upcoming Patriots versus Steelers football game.

items.title: Mustang Winter Sports Report
items.summary: Nick Hennessy provided updates on Medford High School swim, basketball, track, and hockey teams, highlighting key roster performances and recent results.
